sources.title: Ipotesi di accordo di rinnovo CCNL Farmacie comunali 2027-2029, 15 settembre 2026

notes.text: Salary model: conglobated. Allegato B shows unified retribuzione di base with no separate contingenza or EDR columns. Back-calculation: L1=2109.97/173=12.20 EUR/h, L3=1777.29/173=10.27 EUR/h, L6=1421.48/173=8.22 EUR/h (all consistent with divisor 173).
Hourly divisor 173: Art. 18 explicit: 'La quota oraria di retribuzione si ottiene dividendo la retribuzione mensile per 173'.
Additional months: 14. Art. 20 explicit: quattordicesima (luglio) + tredicesima (dicembre).
IQ (Indennita Quadri): Allegato C, effective 01/07/2022. Levels 1Q=160, 1S=150, 1C=145 EUR/month.

IS (Indennita Speciale): Art. 19bis + Allegato A. Level 1+12anni=130, Level 1+2anni=100 EUR/month. Unchanged in 2022 renewal (Allegato C covers only IQ increments; Art. 19bis refers to Tabella A 2015 values).
Seniority: 15 scatti biennali per Allegato E, decorrenza 1 gennaio 2014.

Apprenticeship: Allegato F, under-classification. Farmacista collaboratore stays at Primo livello for all 36 months (levels_below=0). Non-pharmacist roles (Coadiutore, Capo settore, Addetto amministrativo): months 1-12 at Sesto, months 13-36 at Quinto, exit Quarto.
Contract valid 07/07/2022-31/12/2024, ultrattivo since 01/01/2025 (no successor deposited at CNEL as of 2026-09-05). Third tranche (01/07/2024) modelled open-ended.

INPS RATES. Terziario proxy used. ASSOFARM entities operate as aziende speciali or società di gestione farmacia (private-law entities under municipal control); the contract is registered CNEL H124 and negotiated by UGL Terziario — standard private-sector INPS regime (terziario) is the expected classification. Note: CCNL text references "INPS Gestione ex INPDAP" in benefit provisions, suggesting legacy workers transferred from public-sector management may retain the ex-INPDAP pension regime — contribution rates for those workers differ. No sector-specific INPS circular identified; kitech.it does not list a dedicated contribution table for farmacie municipalizzate. Simplification retained.

limitation.remediation: Verify the INPS classification against a sector circular, including ex-INPDAP legacy workers.

notes.text: Levels 1_12 and 1_2 (Farmacista Collaboratore with 12+ or 2+ years continuous service) are automatic time-in-grade progressions under Art. 19bis. Engine cannot model auto-advancement; implemented as static level codes distinguishable by IS allowance amount (1_12=130, 1_2=100 EUR/month). Structural engine limitation — correct payroll calculation requires knowing the worker's actual time-in-grade.

Function and Tech-Prof allowances shown in kitech for L2/L3/quadri sub-levels are EXCLUDED. They appear in no allegato of the signed CCNL; Art. 17 defines retribuzione di base as Tabelle A+B only. Verification: 1Q base+IQ=2456.91+160=2616.91 vs kitech 2758.68; delta 141.77 = sum of the two extra kitech lines — confirming they are historical/personal elements outside the contractual minimum. Exclusion is correct.

RENEWAL 2027-2029 (ipotesi of 15 September 2026, Allegati B-E pp. 20-22; the parties report the definitive signature of 23 October 2026, whose text is not public): the retribuzione base mensile from 1 October 2026, 1 July 2027, 1 July 2028 and 1 July 2029 is modelled; level 6 is abolished and paid as level 5 from 1 October 2026 (art. 10). Not modelled: the una tantum of Allegato D (two instalments with the January and July 2027 pay, 290.00 to 190.00 EUR per instalment by level), and the seniority of a former level 6 worker, kept at the level 6 amounts already matured.

limitation.remediation: Check the definitive text of 23 October 2026, model the una tantum of Allegato D as una tantum items, then remove this note.

notes.text: SICKNESS (Art. 32, CCNL 7 luglio 2022, PDF pp. 24-25; the renewal of 2026 leaves it unchanged): comporto 'mesi 16' up to three years of service and 'mesi 24' above; 'Si considera prosecuzione del periodo di malattia e/o infortunio quella che intervenga non oltre i 60 giorni dalla ripresa del servizio'; integration 'a partire dal primo giorno di malattia e per un massimo di 12 mesi', 100% for the first 6 and 50% for the next 6. Modelled as sickness_rules.cumulation over the chain; the 365 days in full of an oncological illness (c. 17) and the TBC rules (c. 4) are not modelled. Source: https://www.assofarm.it/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/CCNL2022.2024.signedcorrect.pdf, sha256 31dbf30a09f942830176634dff56320a55b830e07cee11f5629595192d852365.

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Articolo 20 - Tredicesima e quattordicesima mensilita' (p. 20): "Le frazioni di mese pari o superiori a 15 giorni vengono computate come mese intero e si trascurano quelle inferiori.". Match: at_least 15.

reviews.scope: Apprentice seniority: art. 23 (p. 21, OCR) and Allegato F of the CCNL of 7 July 2022, with art. 41 c. 1 D.Lgs. 81/2015.
findings: Art. 23 c. 1: 'Il lavoratore a tempo indeterminato ha diritto a 15 scatti biennali di anzianità'; apprenticeship 'è un contratto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato' (D.Lgs. 81/2015 art. 41 c. 1) and the CCNL excludes no apprentice: the increments of the level the apprentice is paid at.

reviews.scope: Ipotesi Farmacie comunali 2027-2029 of 15 September 2026: art. 10 and Allegati B-E (pp. 10, 20-22, page images).
findings: Four tranches of the retribuzione base mensile from October 2026 to July 2029; level 6 abolished into level 5; quadri allowances and seniority amounts unchanged; the base of level 1C at 31 December 2024 is printed 2,266.38 (the file has 2,266.37).

reviews.scope: Monthly values on scanned pages, each read twice from the page image by two independent sessions of another model, the second without being told the expected value.
findings: 37 values read identically by both readings and equal to the file.

reviews.scope: Sick pay and comporto against the research of a separate model session; quotes checked on the source.
findings: Replaced 180 days of one episode with the chain of art. 32 reset after 60 days, comporto 16 or 24 months, 6 months in full and 6 at half pay.

reviews.scope: Number of monthly pays: the article on the additional months located in the cited file by sha256.
Holidays falling on a Sunday: the clause located in the cited file by sha256 (or the law where the CCNL is silent).

location.quote: L’azienda corrisponderà per ogni anno solare nei mesi di giugno e dicembre una quattordicesima e una tredicesima mensilità; il loro importo sarà pari alla retribuzione del mese precedente a quello in cui vengono corrisposte.

provenance.transformation: 14 monthly pays: twelve and the additional months the article sets.
provenance.note: Scanned PDF: the quote is read from the OCR of the page.

provenance.transformation: Comporto of 16 months up to three years of service and 24 above (months of 30 days: 480 and 720 days); 100% for 6 months and 50% for the next 6, at most 12 months; an illness within 60 days of the return continues the previous one.

location.quote: in assenza di una contrattazione collettiva che disciplini compiutamente il congedo parentale su base oraria, i genitori lavoratori dipendenti possono fruire del congedo parentale ad ore in misura pari alla metà dell’orario medio giornaliero

provenance.transformation: The CCNL text read sets no rule on the parental leave by the hour, nor the hours of a day of leave: the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 applies (documents read: https://w, sha256 063a3548487866acce38f2771d8b29271b07a993c954294288b244854be1aae5).

location.quote: 6. Quando una delle festività non domenicali coincida con la domenica, è dovuto a ciascun lavoratore, in aggiunta al normale trattamento economico, un importo pari ad una giornata di retribuzione, (non si applica per la festività civile del 4° novembre in quanto “assorbita” per il concorso alla formazione del monte ore di riduzione orario di lavoro).

provenance.transformation: L'art. 13, c. 6 paga le festività non domenicali quando cadono di domenica ed esclude il 4 novembre. L'art. 13, c. 5 del CCNL 2022–2024 (https://www.assofarm.it/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/CCNL2022.2024.signedcorrect.pdf; sha256 31dbf30a09f942830176634dff56320a55b830e07cee11f5629595192d852365) definisce i giorni festivi come quelli stabiliti dalla legge più il Santo Patrono del luogo di lavoro. I codici elencano tali festività nazionali non domenicali e patron; includono le tre festività civili pagate per legge. La clausola prevede una giornata di retribuzione ma non nomina un divisore, né stabilisce gli altri flag.
